name: new_v2_independent_ring_frequency_full_candidate_leave_one_family_out_v1
data_splits: Exact three ROAM posture, GRAB unseen-user and GRAB cross-day source/validation/final partitions from frozen ring × frequency interaction. Previously saved full and two removal arms must replay byte-identical target probabilities; only ring_lag+frequency_direction is newly source-fitted.
classifier: Same source-only StandardScaler and LogisticRegression C=1 max_iter=2000, balanced for ROAM only, fixed study-specific seeds as parent
metric_direction: Full minus removed: positive macro-F1 and positive removed-minus-full log loss/Brier means retained family helped the candidate full bank
selection: Diagnostic leave-one-family-out for a candidate full bank that failed all three parent validation splits; do not treat it as a selected deployment bank. Keep validation and descriptive final separate.
scope: Eight-channel public 200/2048 Hz native bout/trial ablation. These three split results are correlated public evidence; no historical formula, own-device, or live-performance claim.
